long_biography.plain_text:
Grewal's operating history in UK food service reaches back to the 1990s, when he became a director of companies running pizza restaurants. He built a network of Domino's franchises through vehicles including Bansols Beta and MSG Sandhurst, and accumulated a disclosed stake in Domino's Pizza Group as the British master franchise expanded.

Property, fitness, coffee and an Islay whisky distillery now sit alongside those restaurant operations. Grewal remains a director or controlling person across numerous operating and holding companies, and companies under his control have continued to acquire franchise businesses. The pattern is one of active ownership: a long-running food-service platform supporting a broader portfolio without replacing the restaurant operations at its centre.
